source_hash_notes: All 12 canonical governance files unchanged between runs

timestamp_variance_explanation.explanation: The build_pipeline.py embeds ISO 8601 timestamps in generated_at, release_timestamp, and generation_timestamp fields of JSON and YAML outputs. These fields represent when the file was generated and are expected to differ between runs by design.
timestamp_variance_explanation.impact: Byte-level hashes of timestamp-bearing JSON/YAML files will differ between runs. This is not a defect.
timestamp_variance_explanation.mitigation: Governance artifact integrity is verified via SHA-256 of canonical Markdown source files (which are immutable inputs), not of timestamp-bearing generated outputs.
timestamp_variance_explanation.precedent: Standard practice per build reproducibility guidance. Content-addressable builds may strip timestamps; this pipeline treats timestamps as expected variance.

conclusion: The governance build pipeline is STRUCTURALLY_DETERMINISTIC. Given identical canonical source files, the pipeline produces structurally identical outputs with expected timestamp variance in generated metadata fields. Validation results are fully reproducible (240/240 PASS on both runs). Status: BUILD_DETERMINISTIC_WITH_EXPECTED_TIMESTAMP_VARIANCE.
